points.sub: The one piece of kit on show all match
First shared ball across the big three

caption:
Nike takes over UEFA's ball.

Nike is the new official match ball provider for the Champions League, Europa League and Conference League, plus the Super Cup, Youth League and Futsal Champions League. It runs four seasons, from 2027-28 to 2031, and no fee was disclosed.

It is the first time all three major UEFA men's club competitions share one ball provider. A ball is in shot for every minute of every match, so that is a lot of airtime.

Also in today's partnerships: TotalEnergies x FDJ United, Archer x Formula 1, Novibet x Panathinaikos, 1Cover x Crusaders and Nasdaq x Mercedes-AMG F1.
